name.ja: <ruby>雲海竜<rt>ロストリーム</rt></ruby> ミューラ

requirement.en: Send the top card of your Deck to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Equip this card to 1 face-up WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monster on your field as an Equip Spell Card with the following effect.  Then, you can Special Summon 1 WIND Attribute Sea Serpent Type monster from your hand face-up to your field. ●The equipped monster cannot be returned to the hand, Deck, or Extra Deck by card effects.
